contrastSets.title: Accept or receive?
contrastSets.subtitle: Compare accepting an idea, receiving a signal or item, and confirming receipt.

contrastSets.title: Need, must, or should?
contrastSets.subtitle: Separate practical need, strict necessity, and recommendation or expectation.

contrastSets.title: Discover or invent?
contrastSets.subtitle: One finds what already exists; the other creates something new.

contrastSets.title: Suitable or fitting?
contrastSets.subtitle: Compare a verb-like fit relationship with an adjective-like judgment.

contrastSets.title: Finally, in the end, or ultimately?
contrastSets.subtitle: Separate relief after a process, sequence position, and formal final outcome.

contrastSets.title: Change, modify, adjust, or optimize?

contrastSets.title: Continue, persist, or be continuous?

contrastSets.title: Improve, raise, or increase?

contrastSets.title: Requirement, demand, or need?
